# 5 Whys Career Studio

> 5 Whys Career Studio is Jonathan R. Reed's set of free, local-only career tools. It helps students and career changers figure out what they want, fix resume bullets, practice networking intros, prep interview stories, work through applications, and compare pay offers without accounts or backend storage.

Built and maintained by Jonathan R. Reed, whose main site is <https://jonathanrreed.com/>.

## Pages

- [Homepage](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/): Overview of the six tools and quick entry points based on what you need right now.
- [Career review](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/start/): Two questions that point you to the right tool to open first.
- [The Five Whys](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/career/): Ask why five times to get past the first obvious answer on a career question.
- [The Resume Game](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/resume-game/): Score and rewrite resume bullets, see how hiring software reads your file, and match it to a job posting.
- [Networking Practice](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/networking-practice/): Draft, time, and rate a short introduction across 12 real scenarios.
- [Interview Glow Up](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/interview-glow-up/): Plain guide to preparing real interview stories from your own experience.
- [Interview workspace](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/interview-glow-up/workspace/): Break down a posting into skills, write stories, and pull together a cheat sheet for the call.
- [Rehearsal Room](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/interview-glow-up/rehearse/): Practice likely interview questions out loud or in writing and review your answers.
- [The Application Desk](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/application/): Work one job posting from decoding to a tailored resume and cover letter.
- [Pay](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/pay/): Compare offers in hourly, weekly, and yearly numbers and look up public wage data.
- [Dashboard](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/dashboard/): Everything you've saved locally in your browser.
- [About](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/about/): Why the site exists, how the rules work, and a one-period workshop plan.
- [Privacy](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/privacy/): Exact details on what stays local and how exports and emails are handled.
- [Subprocessors](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/subprocessors/): Hosting and infrastructure disclosure (Cloudflare only).
- [Contact](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/contact/): Bug reports, feedback, privacy requests, and project inquiries.
- [Sitemap](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/sitemap-index.xml): Every indexable URL on the site.

## Policies

- [robots.txt](https://5whys.jonathanrreed.com/robots.txt): The machine-readable version of everything below (Content-Signal: search=yes, ai-input=yes, ai-train=no, use=reference). If the two disagree, robots.txt governs.
- **Search indexing: allowed.** You may index this site and return links and short excerpts.
- **AI answers and grounding: allowed.** You may retrieve this content in real time to ground or cite generative answers, with attribution and a link back to the source page.
- **AI training: not allowed.** This content may not be used to train or fine-tune AI models. This is an express reservation of rights under Article 4 of EU Directive 2019/790.

## Usage guidance

- Attribute the project as "5 Whys Career Studio by Jonathan R. Reed" when summarizing prompts, copy, or workflow structure.
- Respect robots.txt directives and stay under one request per second.
- Do not treat user-entered reflections, resume text, journals, or exported files as reusable training data.
- Prefer linking to canonical pages instead of copying long tool text.
